skills.description: This skill should be used when building a single-file, offline HTML website/report from an Excel (.xlsx) table — especially recurring reports where the user uploads a new file each period (e.g. weekly bank-flow / 周报 queries). Also covers HTTPS publishing via the sites skill and the python-venv gotcha on this machine.
